title: Give Every Worker a Bike

concept.title: The set of taken bikes is the whole state
body: There are `w` workers and `b` bikes (`w <= b`) placed on a plane. Give each worker a **different** bike so that the total of the Manhattan distances (`|x1 - x2| + |y1 - y2|`) is as small as possible. Trying all assignments means `b! / (b - w)!` possibilities, 362 880 for 9 and 9. The assignment of a worker only depends on **which bikes are already taken**, not on who took which one, so the number of different situations is only `2^b`.

Process the workers in order. The set of taken bikes tells how many workers are done (its number of 1 bits), so it is enough as the state. For worker `i` try every free bike, add the distance, and ask for the best result of the remaining workers with one more bike taken:

This is **memoised recursion over subsets**. Note that `i` is not part of the memo key because it can be computed from `used`. The same pattern solves many assignment-like problems: the order of the workers is fixed, and the bikes are the set that changes.

statement: On a plane there are `w` workers and `b` bikes (`w <= b`), each with integer coordinates. Give each worker exactly one bike and no bike to two workers. The cost of giving a bike to a worker is the Manhattan distance between them. Print the smallest possible total cost.
inputFormat: The next `w` lines have the coordinates `x y` of the workers.
The next `b` lines have the coordinates `x y` of the bikes.

examples.note: Worker 1 takes bike 1 (distance 3) and worker 2 takes bike 2 (distance 3): total 6. The other way costs 8.

hints: Handle the workers one after another; for each try every bike that is still free.
The set of used bikes (a bit mask) tells how many workers are done.
Store the best remaining cost for every mask.

starter.python:
w, b = map(int, input().split())
workers = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(w)]
bikes = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(b)]

# Your code here

explanation: The workers are handled in order and the mask of taken bikes is the state: the best cost for the rest is the minimum over free bikes of the distance plus the best cost with that bike taken. A dictionary keyed by the mask stores each state once.
